kind: read-only interface review for possible post-probe production decision
head: cb07f2657236843eb7a1b992a4e2fccbc245d240

observations.fact: Existing output directory rejects another manifest before EE calls; invocation and call budgets are per output directory.
Ingest accepts one released full-plan manifest and its complete bound outputs; partial or sampled manifests do not accumulate into an extraction stage.
Checker reports budget counts and projection, but exit status is numerical/binding violations only; checkpoint reviewer must compare counts/caps and normal runner stop separately.

decision: Existing full/c8 releases unchanged. Run the released c8 probe only at its established boundary. Evaluate material benefit before requesting any migration implementation. Continuing c4 needs no identity migration. A different production identity cannot reuse c4 pieces by relabeling. No code changes or extra cloud work authorized by this review.
